evidence.summary: New mappings states are accessible: loading role=status aria-busy with label, error role=alert with named keyboard-reachable Retry, empty role=region with a real Import Center link; lineup ScopeBar is role=toolbar aria-label=Scope, all controls Tab-reachable with handlers and visible focus. Non-blocking findings: weak focus indicator on Import Center (outline none), focus lost to body after Retry, filter chips lack aria-pressed (state by colour only), deferred 'Propose candidates' uses native disabled so its explanation is keyboard-unreachable (pre-existing). Screen reader, zoom/reflow and 390px not tested.
